Package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.bitol.odps

package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.bitol.odps
Beans and enumerations for the Bitol Open Data Product Standard (ODPS) v1.x (https://bitol-io.github.io/open-data-product-standard/). DataProduct is the root of the document.
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.bitol
    Support for the Bitol open standards for data contracts and data products (https://github.com/bitol-io).
    org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.bitol.common
    Beans and enumerations shared by the Bitol Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) and Open Data Product Standard (ODPS), including the abstract BitolDocument root that Jackson uses to select the document type from the "kind" property.
    org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.bitol.mapping
    Mappers that catalogue Bitol documents in open metadata (and, in later phases, generate them from open metadata).
    org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.bitol.odcs
    Beans and enumerations for the Bitol Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) v3.x (https://bitol-io.github.io/open-data-contract-standard/).
  • Class
    Description
    DataProduct
    This class represents an Open Data Product Standard (ODPS) data product as defined by the Bitol project (https://bitol-io.github.io/open-data-product-standard/).
    DataProductInputContract
    This class identifies a data contract that an output port of an Open Data Product Standard (ODPS) data product depends on.
    DataProductInputPort
    This class represents an input port of an Open Data Product Standard (ODPS) data product.
    DataProductManagementPort
    This class represents a management port of an Open Data Product Standard (ODPS) data product.
    DataProductManagementPortContent
    DataProductManagementPortContent lists the types of content available through a management port of an ODPS data product.
    DataProductManagementPortType
    DataProductManagementPortType lists the types of access to a management port of an ODPS data product.
    DataProductOutputPort
    This class represents an output port of an Open Data Product Standard (ODPS) data product.
    DataProductSBOM
    This class represents a link to a software bill of materials (SBOM) for an output port of an Open Data Product Standard (ODPS) data product.
    DataProductType
    DataProductType lists the common architectural types of an ODPS data product (v1.1.0, RFC 0029); organizations may define their own.
